headline: Profit surges year over year despite a softer quarter
summary_short: Revenue was $1,986M, +18.9% y/y but -6.3% q/q; diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 97.5% y/y yet fell 13.8% q/q, and operating cash flow swung to -$242M from +$17M a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,986M, up 18.9% y/y but down 6.3% q/q. Gross margin rose to 86.2%, roughly +340bp q/q and +290bp y/y despite the revenue pullback. Operating margin held near 25.8% (26.6% q/q, 16.2% y/y). Net income was $397M and diluted EPS $1.56, both +97.5% y/y while down roughly 14% q/q. Total cash fell 20.1% q/q to $2,288M (still +50.7% y/y). Operating cash flow swung to -$242M from +$17M a year earlier.
